claim.claim-text: 2. A display device (10_1) according to claim 1, wherein the external electrodes (OE) cross the first extension portion (41) of the first bank (40).
3. A display device (10_1) according to claim 2, wherein the internal electrodes (IE) cross the first extension portion (41) of the first bank (40).

4. A display device (10_1) according to claim 2, wherein the internal electrodes (IE) are spaced apart from the first extension portion (41) of the first bank (40) and are in the emission regions (EMA).
5. A display device (10_1) according to any one of claims 1 to 4, further comprising:

a plurality of first contact electrodes (26) respectively contacting ones of the external electrodes (OE) and one end portion of the light emitting elements (30); and a plurality of second contact electrodes (27) respectively contacting ones of the internal electrodes (IE) and another end portion of the light emitting elements (30).
6. A display device (10_1) according to any one of claims 1 to 5, further comprising: a plurality of second banks (45) on the substrate (SUB) and overlapping the internal electrodes (IE).

8. A display device (10_3) according to claim 7, wherein the first electrode (21) and the second electrode (22) partially overlap the first extension portion (41) of the first bank (40), and wherein the third electrode (23) does not overlap the first extension portion (41) of the first bank (40).

9. A display device (10_3) according to claim 8, wherein: the display device (10_3) further comprises a second bank (45) between the substrate (SUB) and the third electrode (23) and extending in the second direction (DR2).
